Bundled: [FPDF](http://www.fpdf.org) 1.9 (`fpdf.php`) and its four core Helvetica font metric
files, used by `includes/class-bd-pdf.php` to render the result report as a PDF with no
Composer dependency and no external service.

FPDF's license (see upstream `license.txt`) is permissive and attribution is not required, but
is noted here along with the version for future maintenance. Do not edit `fpdf.php` directly;
replace the whole file on upgrade.
